# Hazards — which `fli check` rule grades each one

Generated. The realm skills' indexes (`.claude/skills/{data,api,ui}-hazards/SKILL.md`)
are the source of the list; a `fli check` rule declares the hazard it grades with
`hazard: '<realm>: <prefix of the bold lead>'` and is read off that table, and
`fli check`'s `hazard-enforcer` reds a key matching no bullet or two.

**`none` is an answer.** A hazard no rule grades reads exactly like one that is
graded, and lives only in prose — so every new session re-learns it by failing.

Graded: **13 of 176**.
